content:
ajay: kicking off region-ordered rollout for v3.2.1. plan: US -> EU -> APAC, 10% slice, 30m observation per slice. pin fallback to v3.2.0 if errors spike.
maria: noted. are quotas and burst cushions validated for US?
kevin: checked reserved GPU headroom in US pools: +15% cushion, autoscale policy active. embedding queues look healthy.
olivia: EU capacity checked but need to confirm burst quota with infra team (tickets open). recommended increase to handle 3x peak for first 5m.
ajay: ok keep EU staged at 5% until we confirm burst. APAC will be last.
deploy-bot: deploy request received for service/model redwood-gen:v3.2.1 -> US slice-1. Canary=10% traffic.
sre-bot: preflight checks: latency p50/p95 within expected, KV cache warmup OK, no long GC.
maria: release notes posted to releases.google: "v3.2.1: kernel selector fix, kv-cache coldstart smoothing, improved batching heuristics"
kevin: rollback trigger agreed: >=2% request error rate OR p95 latency > 1200ms for >5 minutes. activate auto-pin on rollback.
ajay: agree. manual rollback window 0-15m if flapping. auto-pin to v3.2.0 on alert.
olivia: tagging ops:APAC-handoff in 45m. we'll run capacity-smoke for APAC region before traffic shift.
deploy-bot: US slice-1: rollout 10% -> success. observability: no errors, p95 +4%.
maria: start 30m watchtimer. please ping if any anomalous trends.
kevin: setting synthetic traffic probes -rps=50 for 10m against US slice-1 to validate long-tail.
sre-bot: probe results: 10m stable, error rate 0.3%, p95 latency within +6%.
ajay: green for US. proceed to EU at 5% with burst cap until infra confirms.
deploy-bot: EU slice-A: deploy initiated at 5% with burst cap enabled.
olivia: EU burst request approved at +20% until minute 10, then drop to normal.
maria: quick note — update console runbooks to reflect new rollback thresholds (2%/1200ms).
kevin: watching telemetry. also enabling prefix-KV cache warm prefetch for EU to reduce recompile spikes.
sre-bot: EU initial telemetry: slight uptick in token CPU for model-host group but within thresholds.
deploy-bot: EU slice-A: 5% -> stable, now stepping to 15% per plan.
ajay: reminder: if any region crosses thresholds, immediately pin that region and halt downstream regions.
maria: APAC handoff scheduled. APAC will get pre-warm run at T+90m before traffic.
kevin: documenting rollback steps in thread: 1) pin route to v3.2.0 2) scale down new variant 3) trigger incident playbook if >30m.
olivia: I'll coordinate with support for customer-facing comms if we hit rollbacks.
sre-bot: final status: US ok -> EU ok, APAC pre-warm queued. no rollback. :thumbsup:
ajay: thanks team. keep this channel for any fast comms or manual overrides. deploying final traffic slices in 20m.
maria: noted, I'll post a short summary in #releases when complete.
